name: Youchuu Rinne ~Ishukan Harami Rape Sare, Unda Mushi ni Futatabi Jusei Saserareru **Gakusei(-tachi)~
original_name: 妖蟲輪廻 ～異種姦孕みレイプされ、産んだ蟲に再び受精させられる○学生（達）～
source:
On the road home in early summer. A dilapidated house in an unlikely place sat quietly. She was young with an inquisitive spirit and pried inside.

The master of the house seized her.

In the dozens of hours that followed the little girl was ferried to a world of pleasure not known on this earth. Her body, undeveloped and innocent, became vessel to something beyond love's touch. Something nameless.

The mating was endless...

Her belly felt the life of the unspeakable...

Whether she remain here forever, or return to school, bloat with spawn or collapse inwardly like a black hole of lust...

In a discord of physical consumption; the young girl was mother to the spawn beyond imagination. She gave exquisite birth to things no human has ever seen, and when the last convulsions of labor finally ceased, her own offspring began the rape anew. Anew.

translation:
初夏放学回家的路上，一栋破败的老宅静静伫立在不起眼的角落里。年幼的少女按捺不住旺盛的好奇心，悄悄探头溜了进去。

屋子的主人一把抓住了她。

在随后的数十个小时里，小女孩被带往了一个人世间闻所未闻的快感深渊。她那尚未发育成熟、纯洁无瑕的身体，沦为了承载某种超越爱抚、不可名状之物的容器。

交配永无止境……

她的腹中感受到了那难以言喻的异形胎动……

无论是永远被囚禁于此，还是重返校园；无论是腹部被虫卵撑得高高隆起，还是如色欲的黑洞般从内部彻底崩坏……

在肉体被肆意吞噬的扭曲狂宴中，年幼的少女成了超乎想象的魔物之母。她在极致的痉挛中产下了人类从未见过的诡异后代；而当分娩的最后一道阵痛终于平息时，由她亲生孕育的子嗣们，又一次对她开始了新一轮的强暴。周而复始，永不停歇。
